steps.en: Clone the repo, install locked deps, build Studio and start the local service
steps.zh: 克隆仓库、装锁定依赖、构建 Studio 并启动本机服务
steps.code: npm ci · npm run build:studio · npm start

steps.en: Register its stdio MCP server in your agent, pointing at the same data directory
steps.zh: 在你的 agent 里登记它的 stdio MCP 服务，指向同一个数据目录

steps.en: Hand the agent a reference clip or template, your brand kit and copy
steps.zh: 把参考视频或模板、品牌资料和文案交给 agent

steps.en: Its skills guide the agent to break the reference down and write HTML scenes into a project
steps.zh: 它的 skill 引导 agent 拆解参考片，把 HTML 场景写进工程

steps.en: Review in Studio; move clips yourself or ask the agent for another revision
steps.zh: 在 Studio 里看片，自己挪片段或让 agent 再改一版

steps.en: Renders the saved revision to MP4 and checks codec, size, fps, duration and decoding
steps.zh: 把保存的版本渲染成 MP4，并检查编码、尺寸、帧率、时长和解码

value.en: An MP4 remake in your brand with its HTML source kept editable, without keyframing it by hand or paying a per-render fee
value.zh: 得到套上你品牌的 MP4 复刻片，HTML 源码仍可再改，不用手调关键帧，也不按渲染次数付费
